Description.header: Reports completed files placed in a shared staging directory.
Description.body: Copy files through the returned request-local input directory link. The relative link resolves to a hidden staging directory on the same shared API volume and therefore works when that volume has different host and container mount paths. Each open-and-drain of the events FIFO returns one JSON batch containing every ready event accumulated since the previous delivered batch. The result FIFO returns one final summary after the event session becomes idle. Files remain in staging and are not copied to /uploads.
Description.footer: Read events through EOF; a FIFO is a byte stream and one read call is not a message boundary. Producers should atomically rename completed files into input.
